text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna pack on the weight! I'm gonna 
get super buff!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because I... I just fell sick the 
other day too...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Tsuru-chan, are you all right? I have 
prepared some porridge for you~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
T-Thanks for the food... *munch munch*... 
*munch munch*...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh... that's weird... I can't taste 
anything, it doesn't feel like I'm 
eating... Everything's spinning around and 
around...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flop~)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And so, I lost some weight... Now I'm in 
the middle of bulking up! Fight on, 
Tsuyoshi! That's how it is!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Tsuru-chan, I brought it over~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Here's the extra-large teriyaki chicken 
set meal, desu!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Well then, time to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Eat meat, then rice! Eat rice, then meat! 
Chomp! Chomp! Over and over again!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Go, go! Tsuru-chan! Fight on, fight on! 
Tsuru-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
By the time you finish eating this, you're 
definitely gonna be totally ripped~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Whew... *pant*... *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Are you all right...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You have the option to give up, you know? 
You can always come back for revenge!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
No!! I can... I can still keep going...! 
Compared to when I'm sick... this is... 
nothing at all...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*Munch, munch*... *munch, munch*...! 
*Munch, munch*... *munch, munch*...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Guff!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Tsuru-chan, are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ugh... pretty much... at my limit...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: B-But... even so...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: W-What happened-desu?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm working up an appetite!! If I just 
keep exercising like thiiis~~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! I've never seen anyone jump rope 
so much before...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm so moved! I can't just stand by and 
watch! I propose a digestive dance of my 
own!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That dance really does look great for 
digestion! I'm gonna try it too!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Then, I'll go prepare some tea to help 
with digestion.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *whew*... Nice~, I feel like 
I've cleared up a ton of room in my 
stomach!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Do you have any other ideas for 
how to build up an appetite!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Running for that long is 
bound to make anyone hungry!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Shall El and I join in too~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "Really!? Yes, please!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the three ran long-distance, 
and Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi managed to finish 
every bite.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
!! Obvious, yet so profound! All right, 
I'll stay completely still!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Even if... I don't do... anything... Guh, 
the sleepiness is... endure it... 
Tsuyoshi...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though hit by a wave of drowsiness from 
being so full, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi somehow 
managed to push through and finish every 
last bite.
